fields.description: A short name for this rule. It is written into the Triton call log when the rule fires, so name it the way you would describe it out loud: "After hours", "Service calls to Rich", "Weekend on-call".
fields.label: Rule Name

fields.description: Untick to park a rule without deleting it. Disabled rules are never sent to the gateway.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Lower numbers are checked first, and the FIRST rule that matches wins — nothing after it is considered. Leave gaps (10, 20, 30) so a rule can be slotted in between later without renumbering everything.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: All of the conditions in this section and the next must be true for the rule to fire.
fields.label: Which calls

fields.description: Which option the caller pressed in the phone menu. "General" is what they get for pressing nothing.
fields.label: Menu Selection
fields.options:
Any
Rental
Design
Build
Service
General

fields.description: "Known customer" means the calling number is already on a Customer or Contact record.
fields.label: Who Is Calling
fields.options:
Any caller
Known customer
Unknown caller
Matching numbers

fields.description: One number per line. A partial number is a prefix, so 801 matches every 801 number and 8015551234 matches exactly one. Leaving this empty makes the rule match nothing rather than everything.
fields.label: Calling From

fields.description: Days this rule covers. "Any time" ignores the clock entirely.
fields.label: Days
fields.options:
Any time
Every day
Weekdays
Weekends
Custom days

fields.description: Free text, e.g. "Mon, Wed, Fri" or "Tue & Thu".
fields.label: Which Days

fields.description: Start of the window, in office time. A window that ends EARLIER than it starts wraps past midnight: 17:00 to 08:00 means evenings and early mornings. Note that the day filter above still applies to the day the call arrives, so a Weekdays 17:00-08:00 rule covers Monday-Friday evenings and Monday-Friday early mornings — it does not stretch Friday evening into Saturday.
fields.label: From

fields.description: End of the window. Leave both times blank to cover the whole of the selected days.
fields.label: Until

fields.description: Skip this rule on dates in the Holiday List chosen in Call Routing Settings. Tick it on your normal office-hours rule so holidays fall through to the after-hours rule below it.
fields.label: Skip On Holidays

fields.description: Everything listed here rings at the same time.
fields.label: Ring

fields.description: Also ring the desk and browser softphones as usual, in addition to the targets below. Leave this on unless you specifically want ONLY the people listed to be reachable — a rule with this off and a bad target list is how a call reaches nobody.
fields.label: Also Ring Softphones

fields.description: Seconds to ring before taking a message. Leave at 0 to use the default in Call Routing Settings.
fields.label: Ring For (Seconds)

fields.description: Twilio rings at most 10 endpoints on one call, softphones included. Anything past the tenth is not dialed.
fields.label: Targets
